svg.text: Power/ground shown as net labels — same label (3V3, 5V, GND) is the same electrical node

g.text: Common-anode: GPIO LOW = that color ON
Active-LOW trigger — GPIO LOW = relay ON
• 3V3 / 5V / GND are net labels — same label = same node.
• All grounds (ESP32, RTC, relay, supply) are common.
• External 4.7 kΩ I²C pull-ups shown for SDA/SCL.
• RGB LED is common-anode; GPIO LOW turns a color ON.
• Relay module is active-LOW (GPIO LOW → relay ON).
Set RELAY_ACTIVE_HIGH = true in firmware if wired the
• Boot button: INPUT_PULLUP, hold ≥ 5 s for factory reset.
